description: Add CSS rules for the dashboard tab bar (.dashboard-tabs, .dashboard-tab-btn variants) and the .filter-chip-lg modifier to frontend/src/index.css. This feature is independent of FEAT-002 and must run first because FEAT-002's JSX references these classes.
steps: Run 'npm run build' from the frontend directory. Confirm zero errors.
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run build' from the frontend directory completes with zero TypeScript errors and zero Vite CSS errors.
.filter-chip-lg appears in index.css after .filter-chip.active, with the CSS specificity comment above it.
.dashboard-tabs and .dashboard-tab-btn rules (plus :hover, .active, :focus-visible variants) appear in index.css before the ADMIN LAYOUT block comment.
verification: cd frontend && npm run build — expect exit code 0 and no error output.
findings: CSS classes added to index.css as flat top-level rules. .filter-chip-lg inserted immediately after .filter-chip.active (with specificity comment). .dashboard-tabs, .dashboard-tab-btn, .dashboard-tab-btn:hover, .dashboard-tab-btn.active, .dashboard-tab-btn:focus-visible inserted immediately before the ADMIN LAYOUT block comment. Build verified: npm run build exited 0 with no TypeScript or Vite CSS errors. FEAT-002 can now reference .dashboard-tabs, .dashboard-tab-btn, and .filter-chip-lg safely.
